electricity_price_note: Weighted price using 85% PPA and 15% EVN.
holding_cost_basis: 24-month analysis period (2 × annual holding per spare)
holding_cost_formula: 125,000,000 VND/inverter × 8% WACC × 10 inverters = 100,000,000 VND/year for 10 spares
generation_hours_note: Equivalent generation hours per day from 1,467 kWh/kWp/year divided by 365.
